name: GhostToast
description: Plain container (div, no live-region role) for one visible toast. Pauses its auto-dismiss timer while hovered or while focus is inside. Escape with focus inside dismisses only this toast, stops propagation so a dialog behind stays open, and returns focus to the element focused before focus entered the region.

props.name: toast
props.description: Record to render, usually one item of the viewport's `toasts`.

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses only the focused toast and returns focus to where it was before it entered the region.
